claims.text: Handwashing with soap removes bacteria from hands.
claims.explanation: Soap breaks down oils and dirt on skin, allowing water to wash away bacteria.

claims.text: Having fewer bacteria on hands reduces the chance of spreading germs to patients.
claims.explanation: Medical studies consistently show that cleaner hands lower the transmission of harmful germs.

claims.text: Handwashing with soap helps hospitals reduce patient infections.
claims.explanation: Hospitals rely on regular handwashing as a proven way to keep patients safe from infections.

edges.reason: Removing bacteria with soap directly results in fewer germs on hands.
Spreading fewer germs to patients helps hospitals lower their overall infection rates.
